name: Zwoleń County (Poland)
description: Two equal vertical stripes of blue and red, charged at the centre with the county arms of Zwoleń: a shield with a white eagle on red and a yellow letter S with a bird on blue.
history: Polish county (powiat) and city flags are established by resolution of the council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.
